question.text: The solubility of metal halides depends on their nature, lattice enthalpy and hydration enthalpy of the individual ions, amongst fluorides of alkali metals, the lowest solubility of LiF in water is due to

options.text: High hydration enthalpy of lithium ion
Low ionisation enthalpy of lithium atom

solution.text: The lowest solubility of LiF in water is due to strong packing of <math><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">L</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">i</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>+</mo></mrow></msup></math> and <math><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">F</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo></mrow></msup></math> ion, lattice energy of LIF is higher than its hydration energy.
